runtime_discovery: Parent of checks; optional explicit --runtime-root for a complete installation.

generated_fixture.purpose: Real regular package which raises if search-path fallback executes it; no dependency stub

output_limits.basis: Post-collection acceptance threshold for the exact three finite CLI paths; not a capture/RSS guarantee. Enclosing CI controls the process deadline.

enrollment: Future integrator must select the complete runtime and existing interpreter and enroll the command in maintained public CI. These additive files do not edit workflow or registry authority.
qualification_scope: Each result records its actual interpreter build and platform. POSIX is the required interface contract, not proof for every POSIX/CPython combination.
